meta.title: Catcha Group — Entrepreneurs for Entrepreneurs
meta.description: Catcha Group is a family office in Southeast Asia, building and backing market-leading businesses since 1999.

hero.sub: A family office in Southeast Asia, building and backing market-leading businesses since 1999.

about.history: Since 1999, Catcha Group has been building and backing category-defining businesses across Southeast Asia. We have a proven history of seeing opportunities early, moving fast, and executing with discipline — from launching market-leading platforms to taking companies public. Over two decades, we've operated through every market cycle, scaling ideas into industry leaders and building a reputation for turning bold visions into real outcomes.

points.text: A family office run by its principals, so you deal directly with the people who decide.
We invest our own money in every deal and stand shoulder-to-shoulder with the teams we back.
We work side by side with founders to unlock growth, sharpen strategy and build long-term value.

about.close: We only bet where we are willing to put our own money, energy and expertise on the line.

principals.bio: Founded Catcha in 1999 and has taken seven companies from start-up to IPO on the ASX, KLSE and NYSE over 30 years, including iProperty, iCar Asia and Frontier Digital Ventures.

principals.name: Luke Elliott
principals.bio: Co-founded Catcha, with experience in building fast-moving online business models, monetising media assets and executing more than 80 mergers and acquisitions, capital raisings and public listings.
